The marker is deliberately transferred into the returned MarkerLease closure, which owns the exact begin token across possible start delivery and parent cycle. Before a lease is returned, the failure path attempts marker close and rethrows; a residue is not silently removed. A preallocated private stateLock guards retainedStatus reads; caller-visible Attempt is not used as its own monitor. This local synchronization cannot manufacture a client or Unit termination receipt.

Private stateLock keeps retained status, stream-attempt flags and marker-retained gate checks in one compound operation. A zero client exit is insufficient without both closure conditions and external same-owner gates. No actual requireRetained action occurs in this review.

Live-daemon retirement gates and nested retireAfter share the same reentrant private stateLock. After-unlink uncertainty still throws and must be retained by the parent; the monitor is not readiness or retirement proof.

Close-observation sets retireUncertain before invoking the possibly failing marker close. Under the private monitor, a second thread cannot reinterpret that uncertainty as a fresh retirement opportunity. Durable marker presence and actual owner release remain separate.

Status, retired/retiring/uncertain flags and repeated gate/context observations form one private critical section. retireUncertain is set before marker action and retiring is cleared in finally even on failure. This ordering cannot itself authorize real retirement.

Client reaping and stream-attempt cursor changes are serialized by the private preallocated lock. UNKNOWN/null/poison/previous attempt guards prevent issuing another start or repeating an uncertain close. This does not serialize foreign processes or prove worker quiescence.

The obtained stdout alias is explicitly handed to closeBoth, or closeOne if obtaining stderr throws. Those helpers each make one close attempt and report a boolean. There is no successful stream-closure assertion if either attempt fails.

stderr is assigned only from the retained process and then passed to closeBoth; stdout is already protected by a separate acquisition-failure cleanup. A failed close keeps Status.UNKNOWN. The streamsClosed flag means the pair was attempted, not proof that physical descriptors closed.
